limits: Source review only; requires actual generated address width and port topology, legal in-range addressing checks, complete frozen DCache cycle comparison, proof of same-edge duplicate/validity priority including reset, and mapped area before any integration. set_way_contract: S2 uses S2 request address set and OHToUInt(effective way); S3 duplicate and the writer use the held S3 request set and OHToUInt(s3_way). Distinct read addresses must remain independently combinational. Keep both read-before-edge and same-address post-edge semantics.
single_writer_contract: dataWriteArb.io.in(0).fire and s3_req.effect_token_valid, at the same edge as token and validity writes. Probe, refill and cross-package clear change validity but not result payload. Global reset invalidates entries; result payload is uninitialized in parent.
